exposure: AB exposure in the first week of life
cohort: 182 term-born infants (56 exposed to antibiotics in the first week of life, 126 healthy controls)
finding: Antibiotic exposure in the first week of life alters faecal microbiota development with deviations in the relative abundance of individual taxa until 1 year of age.
mod_finding: The effect of antibiotic exposure on the gut microbiome of infants differed by mode of delivery, with vaginally delivered but not C-section infants showing differences in the relative abundance of certain gut bacteria.
